provenance.driver: raw CDP over websocket-client 1.9.0; NO Playwright, no injected page agent
provenance.attach_detail: chrome rejects a WebSocket whose Origin it did not expect (403). --remote-allow-origins=* plus suppress_origin=True are set; both are client-attach concerns and change nothing the page measures.
provenance.invariant: stack_trace_limit=10 and prepare_stack_trace=undefined in every run of both states

interpretation: Runtime.enable is the specific cause of the attached-state timing signal measurement 2 found. State D (bare CDP attach, Page domain only) is indistinguishable from the unattached baseline; state E (same plus Runtime.enable) is elevated ~21% with ZERO distribution overlap across 9 batches each. C's small excess over E (measurement 2) is the Playwright page agent, the confound this measurement removed. D1 option (a) -- never enable the Runtime domain -- therefore closes this vector at the driver layer, and option (b), patching v8/src/inspector, is not warranted by it.
